top_signals.title: Asian Stocks, Bonds to Drop on Oil, Inflation Woes: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks and bonds were set for declines after a surge in oil prices sparked a selloff in US markets, while the latest inflation data reinforced bets on an imminent Federal Reserve rate hike.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
